limitations: No guidance_scale via fal.ai/Replicate (5.5 default via BytePlus)
No scheduler or inference step control
best_for: Product photography and commercial art direction

strengths: Negative prompt support for explicit exclusion
best_for: Iterative refinement with fine parameter control
Image editing with precise strength control

prompt.description: Natural language or JSON structured prompt
prompt.recommended_length: 30-100 words optimal, up to 200+ for complex scenes
prompt.notes: Use double quotation marks for text rendering. Coherent sentences outperform keyword lists.

image_size.description: Output dimensions. Use presets or custom {width, height}.

num_images.description: Number of separate generations to run

max_images.description: Number of images per generation run. Enables multi-image output with style/character consistency.

sync_mode.description: When true, returns data URI instead of URL

image_url.description: Source image URL or base64 for editing. Up to 10 reference images supported.

guidance_scale.description: Only available via BytePlus ModelArk API

seed.description: For reproducibility. Returned in output for reuse.

prompt.description: Natural language prompt. Concise, precise sentences preferred over keyword stacking.

examples: blurry, low quality, distorted faces, extra fingers

num_inference_steps.description: Generation quality steps. Higher = better quality, slower.

guidance_scale.warnings: Values >10 cause oversaturation in ~40% of generations

strength.description: Edit intensity for image editing mode. Lower = closer to original.

image_input.description: Reference images for editing or style transfer

portrait_16_9.use_case: TikTok, Instagram Stories, vertical video frames

seedream_5_lite.extended_length: 200+ words supported without degradation for complex structured scenes
seedream_5_lite.text_rendering: Double quotation marks required around literal text
seedream_5_lite.json_mode: JSON objects accepted for multi-subject positioning
seedream_5_lite.hex_colors: HEX codes with paired color names accepted inline

seedream_4_5.prompt: Natural language, concise preferred over keyword stacking

text_rendering.syntax: Double quotation marks around literal text
text_rendering.note: Without quotes, text becomes descriptive keywords rather than rendered text

json_structured_prompt.syntax: JSON object with scene, subjects array, style, lighting, camera fields

subject_fields.description: string — natural language description of the subject
subject_fields.position: string — spatial placement (e.g., 'upper left', 'lower right third', 'center')

when_to_use: Per-element color control for brand work
Commercial art direction with specific composition
Product flat lays with defined spatial arrangement
when_not_to_use: Simple scenes that don't need positional control

hex_color_control.note: Pair HEX code with a descriptive color name for best results

multi_image_generation.note: Style and character consistency maintained across images in same generation

web_search_trigger.trigger: Include dates, product names, or trending terms
web_search_trigger.note: Model automatically retrieves current visual references

cost_estimates.fal_ai: Per-image pricing not published; usage-based billing
cost_estimates.replicate: Per-prediction pricing; varies by compute time

photorealistic_portrait.prompt_formula: Subject (person, expression, clothing) > Setting (environment) > Style (camera model, film stock) > Lighting (direction, quality) > Technical (lens, aperture, depth of field)

product_photography.notes: Use JSON for precise product placement. Include HEX colors for brand accuracy.

typography_poster.notes: Wrap all rendered text in double quotation marks. Specify font style, hierarchy, and layout.

multi_panel_storyboard.notes: Lock character description word-for-word. Use 'cinematic storyboard grid' framing.

iterative_refinement.notes: Use when fine-tuning requires guidance_scale and negative prompt iteration.

style_transfer_editing.notes: Provide before/after pair + target image. Model learns transformation and applies to new image.

brand_identity_package.notes: Use HEX codes for brand colors. Request 'a set' for style consistency across outputs.

text_not_rendering.problem: Text appears as visual noise or doesn't appear at all
text_not_rendering.cause: Missing double quotation marks around literal text
text_not_rendering.solution: Wrap all text that should render in double quotation marks: "OPEN 24 HOURS"

spatial_confusion.problem: Subjects overlapping or misplaced in multi-subject scenes
spatial_confusion.cause: Plain text prompt too complex for spatial reasoning
spatial_confusion.solution: Switch to JSON structured prompt with explicit position fields per subject

color_drift.cause: Relying on descriptive color names alone
color_drift.solution: Use HEX codes with paired color names: 'color #FF006E hot pink'

contradictory_results.cause: Prompt too long (>200 words) without JSON structure, or contradictory style references
contradictory_results.solution: Simplify prompt, split into JSON fields, or remove contradictory descriptors

inconsistent_characters.problem: Character appearance changes between related images
inconsistent_characters.solution: Copy-paste identical character description word-for-word. Use multi-image generation for batch consistency.

oversaturation_4_5.solution: Keep guidance_scale between 7-9 for most use cases

negative_prompt_not_working.cause: negative_prompt parameter not exposed in 5.0 Lite API
negative_prompt_not_working.solution: Describe desired end state more precisely. Use 4.5 if explicit exclusion control is required.

choose_5_lite_when: Product photography or commercial art direction
Prompts reference current events or products (web search)
JSON structured prompts with HEX color control
choose_4_5_when: Pipeline requires scheduler or inference step control
Image editing with precise strength parameter
Legacy integration where 4.5 API is configured
Simpler scenes where reasoning overhead is unnecessary
Visual marker editing workflows (arrows, boxes, doodles)
